profile.subject: a shiba inu dog
profile.styleHints: red-tan coat with white chest, pricked ears, curled fluffy tail over back

cycle.prompt: Horizontal sprite sheet of exactly 4 frames of the same red shiba inu dog walking, strict side profile facing right, one eye visible, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, legs in trot-walk sequence, curled fluffy tail, pricked ears

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing alert in side view facing right, head up, ears pricked, curled tail high, all four paws planted

rest.label: Sit
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright with front legs straight, hind legs folded, curled tail around side, head up facing right

sleep.label: Sleep curled
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled on side with paws tucked, fluffy tail over nose, eyes closed sleeping peacefully

voice.label: Bark
voice.prompt: Pose: standing facing right with mouth open barking, ears up, curled tail raised and wagging slightly

trick.label: Shake paw
trick.prompt: Pose: sitting and lifting one front paw high to shake, head tilted, tail wagging, facing right

lines: Hi I'm Kuma, your best buddy!
Look at my fluffy curled tail!
I love running on soft green grass
Stay close, I will guard you!
Rub my tummy, I am so happy!

facts.text: Shiba Inus come from Japan and hunted small game in mountains.
Shiba Inus look like tiny foxes with pointy upright ears.
Their fluffy tail curls up and over their back.
